lead.headline: Metcalf drops one on the bench; the week is won — claim Coker
lead.deck: 2-5, heading to 3-5. 139.8 to 36.6 with the Commanders D/ST to play. Claims clear Wednesday 02:00.
lead.body: Start with the bad news, all of it on the bench or the flex: DK Metcalf caught one of six targets and dropped a big one at Cleveland, and Ollie Gordon had 1.6 on six carries with Miami still playing. Neither is hurt as far as any report says. Everything that counted landed — Tuten 29.9 and named the featured back by ESPN, Allen 26.6, Warren 21.3, Hockenson 15.8, Bass 16 — and AVIATO lead Guillo-tinas by 103 with ESPN at 99%. Nothing left this week can be changed. The one move is the claim that undoes Wednesday's mistake: Jalen Coker back, Ka'imi Fairbairn out, before Wednesday 02:00. The afternoon's new wire name is Mike Washington Jr., who took 25 carries from Ashton Jeanty in Las Vegas by the coach's choice; one game, no stated reason, and Tuesday's run decides.
